status: private review export; not approved by a dentist, not for publication

v8_findings.method: Opened the six v8 Blender scenes, read every build/render script, rendered the v8 check stills and compared models and frames with the reference crops in Reference_vs_Model_v8.jpg. Reference hosts were unreachable from the build sandbox, so photographs were not re-downloaded.
shape_and_proportion: Radii-Cal CX body about half its real diameter relative to its length; far end rendered dark grey because all lights sat near the working end.
Surgitip had a double dog-leg instead of one elbow; green insert too thin and long.
FX57 head was a flat cylinder; neck straight and the body sat on the wrong side of the head for a contra-angle; stepped neck/body junction; lettering mirrored in the comparison.
Barrier syringe push rod about 40 % of barrel width against about 60 % in the photograph; label text much smaller than the product's.
Pola hub was a plain cylinder wider than the photograph's ribbed cone; delivery end about 18 mm against about 11-13 mm.
angles_and_contact: All non-scaler poses used a positive X tilt, which sends the handle away from the camera, into the patient. The polisher handle ended about 28 mm behind the tooth plane.
Polisher was seen from behind the head, hiding the brush contact.
Suction and syringes lay almost flat in the image plane, so they read as flat pipes with the suction opening facing up the screen rather than the enamel.
Crown outlines and barrier path were up to about 1.5 mm off the gingival margin on some teeth (the barrier path crossed the enamel of the first illustrated tooth).
material_behaviour: Barrier was a constant-width flat ribbon whose apical edge mirrored every scallop; the clinical reference shows a lumpy band that fills the papillae.
Gel was a grey-blue tint at 32 % that dulled the enamel, with a hard straight lower edge; the clinical reference shows a clear wet coating.
Clear plastics were a flat 24 % transparency mix and read as a ghosted overlay.
Instrument renders were 850 px enlarged about 3x at 24 samples without denoising: soft and grainy in frame.

creative_fit.limits: Visual reconstructions, not manufacturer CAD. Hidden dimensions, the barrier cannula bend and the scaler handpiece remain inferred. Pola in-use and ACTEON tip photographs were not re-inspected in v9.

motion_playback.reason: Continuous normal-speed visual playback was not verified. Sampled encoded frames do not replace this gate.

audio_playback.reason: Intentionally silent; no audio track or listening claim.

equipment_scale: Millimetre models, 80 mm asset-camera span, 32 px/mm on screen from an assumed 8.5 mm central incisor. Not a measured patient calibration.
literal_facts: Initial/final photographs and tooth colours unchanged. Scaling -> barrier -> cure -> gel -> aspirate -> polish order and timings retained. Only six upper anterior crowns illustrated; rinse and barrier removal omitted with a clean cut.
